eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 4:39 PM on AUG 20, 2021 Effective until 4:39 PM AUG 21, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is the Plumas County Sheriffs Office with a MANDATORY EVACUATION for Taylorsville  Zone 15A including Arlington Road and Nelson Street 
All residents must leave these areas IMMEDIATELY due to an imminent threat from the Dixie Fire
You should evacuate south toward Quincy  
If you remain emergency personnel may not be able to help you
